department: Biomedical Sciences, Health Sciences Center (School of Medicine)

deadline.value: Priority deadline is November 1, 2026; completed applications are due December 1, 2026. Fall entry only.
deadline.quote: Completed applications are due December 1, 2026 | Priority deadline - November 1, 2026

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required and are not considered even if sent.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not required and will not be considered if provided

gre_subject.quote: GRE scores are not required and will not be considered if provided

supervisor.value: Students join a common admissions process and rotate through labs in the fall before choosing an advisor.
supervisor.quote: The PhD programs in the Biomedical Sciences share a common admissions process | You will rotate through 3 laboratories during the fall semester to select a dissertation advisor

funding.value: Admitted PhD students receive full support, including a stipend of at least $30,000 and full tuition, while in good standing.
funding.quote: As a PhD student, you will receive full financial support during your training, provided you remain in good academic standing | A minimum of $30,000 stipend

entry_route.value: No master's degree is needed before admission to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: You do not need to complete an MS degree before admittance to the PhD Program in Biomedical Sciences

toefl_min.value: The school page still lists the old-scale TOEFL iBT 79, so no TOEFL minimum is recorded here.

ielts_min.value: The school sets Academic IELTS 6.5 overall.

english_waiver.value: Applicants with citizenship or a bachelor's degree from India do not need to submit English test scores.
english_waiver.quote: If you have citizenship or a bachelor’s degree from one of the following countries then you do not need to submit scores to meet the English language proficiency requirement | Guyana, India, Jamaica

notes: Umbrella program with eight degree-granting tracks (Neuroscience is listed as also_fields). Review begins in November; applications incomplete by March 1 may not be considered. Interviews are held December to March.
name: Biomedical Sciences PhD (eight tracks)
